The same thing happens with 'Vn is ready · Compare' when Present opens while it is up (1440: snackbar y952–1000 over the xxl modal's bottom-left, and its Compare acts on the canvas behind the modal).
newIssues.fix: While an aria-modal dialog is open, place the snackbar below the dialog's bottom edge when there is room, else at bottom-centre above the scrim; or drop the snackbar when the row itself already says 'Copied'. Dismiss the 'Vn is ready · Compare' snackbar when a modal opens.

newIssues.title: Style transfer's reference-colour names disagree between Present and the moodboard and use the wrong kind of finish
newIssues.repro: Kitchen (sample) › Style › Upload a reference photo (public/uat-files/kitchen-moodboard.jpg) › Style transfer › Present, then the version's ⋯ › Moodboard.
newIssues.evidence: Present lists 'Countertops · Reference colour, close to Quartz Calacatta' and a second 'Countertops · Reference colour, close to Linen' (a paint name on a worktop), 'White Painted Walls · close to Linen' and 'Marble Backsplash · close to Basketweave Marble'. The moodboard puts one swatch 'Reference colour, close to Quartz Calacatta' over 'Countertops, Backsplash, Walls, Ceiling · Matte', so it calls the walls and ceiling a quartz and contradicts Present. The floor is 'close to Teak Outdoor'.
newIssues.fix: Resolve the nearest finish per surface kind once (outputs.plainFinishName) and group moodboard swatches by that resolved name, not by the reference hex. In Present, label a surface that repeats a group word by its own name ('Island countertop' / 'Back countertop'). Worktops should snap to stones or countertops, never paints.
